leaky_backpack.name: Leaky Backpack
leaky_backpack.card: If you do not carry a waterproof bag, every water-leak event loses an extra 1 L.

fragile_shoelaces.name: Fragile Shoelaces
fragile_shoelaces.card: If you do not carry duct tape, the first shoelace snap causes HP -1.

cold_sensitive.name: Cold Sensitive
cold_sensitive.card: All cold-related events deal +1 HP (down jacket can cancel 1).

heat_resistant.name: Heat Resistant
heat_resistant.card: Hot weather and sun events deal -1 HP.

climber.name: Climber
climber.card: Slip or fall events deal -1 HP.

allergy_prone.name: Allergy Prone
allergy_prone.card: Bee sting or allergy events deal +1 HP unless carrying allergy medicine.

old_batteries.name: Old Batteries
old_batteries.card: If no spare batteries, the first headlamp-dead event deals HP -1.

hot_drink_lover.name: Hot Drink Lover
hot_drink_lover.card: Whenever you trigger a tea/hot drink HP+ event, gain +1 extra HP (requires stove + pot).

clean_freak.name: Clean Freak
clean_freak.card: If you do not carry disinfectant wipes, the first scavenged-food event gives HP -1.

water_hoarder.name: Water Hoarder
water_hoarder.card: If you carry more than 5 L of water, suffer HP -1 per day (optional for teacher).

light_pack_expert.name: Light Pack Expert
light_pack_expert.card: If total carried weight <= 15 kg, recover HP +1 each night.

repair_expert.name: Repair Expert
repair_expert.card: If you carry a repair kit, equipment-damage events deal -1 HP.

animal_friend.name: Animal Friend
animal_friend.card: Non-attack wildlife encounters always deal HP 0.

night_walker.name: Night Walker
night_walker.card: Night or darkness events deal -1 HP if you have a headlamp.

coffee_bonus.name: Coffee Bonus
coffee_bonus.card: If you carry coffee press + stove, the first fatigue/headache event becomes HP 0.

picky_eater.name: Picky Eater
picky_eater.card: Raw eggs/mushrooms/fish/insects always cause HP -1 even if normally safe, unless cooked (stove).

backup_hammock.name: Backup Hammock
backup_hammock.card: If you have no tent/tarp on rainy nights, exposure HP is reduced by 1.

old_rope.name: Old Rope
old_rope.card: Without rope/tool kit, the first cliff/river crossing event deals +1 HP.
